Sachiya Steel International Private Limited is a TUV and ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer, supplier and exporter of stainless steel pipe fittings, flanges, DIN 3015 tube clamps, industrial fasteners, and seamless and welded pipes & tubes, based in Mumbai, India. We are an approved vendor for SABIC, ADNOC, MAADEN and QATAR ENERGY. With over two decades of in-house manufacturing experience, we supply stainless steel, carbon steel, alloy steel, duplex and super duplex products to engineers, EPC contractors and procurement teams across more than 100 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Africa, Asia and the Americas.
Our product range covers buttweld pipe fittings (elbows, tees, reducers, crosses, bends), forged fittings (couplings, plugs, bushings, end caps and olets — weldolet, sockolet, threadolet), flanges (slip-on, weld neck, blind, socket weld, lap joint, threaded, orifice, puddle and split), seamless and welded pipes and tubes, and a complete line of industrial fasteners including hex bolts, nuts, screws, washers, threaded rods, studs and retaining rings. We also manufacture DIN 3015 tube clamps and pipe clamps in polypropylene, aluminium, carbon steel and stainless steel grades for hydraulic, pneumatic and industrial piping applications.
We maintain ready stock of over 2,000 metric tonnes in our Mumbai warehouse, which allows us to offer short lead times even for bulk orders. All products are manufactured and tested to ASTM, ASME, DIN, ISO and JIS standards, with full material traceability and mill test certificates provided with every shipment. Our clients include SABIC, MAADEN, ADNOC, HPCL, BPCL, KNPC, Qatar Energy and ACCIONA among others.

How We Test
Quality Testing & 
Inspection Methods
Every pipe fitting, flange, pipe, tube, fastener and tube clamp goes through rigorous testing and inspection before dispatch. Here is how we verify quality at each stage of manufacturing.
Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
We use ultrasonic waves to detect internal flaws, cracks and wall thickness variations in pipes, tubes and fittings. This non-destructive test ensures structural integrity before shipment.
Hydrostatic Pressure Testing
All pipes and tubes are subjected to hydrostatic pressure testing per ASTM standards to verify they can withstand the rated working pressure without leaks or deformation.
PMI Testing (Positive Material Identification)
We use XRF analysers to verify the exact chemical composition of every heat of material, ensuring the grade stamped on the product matches the actual alloy content.
Radiography Testing (RT)
X-ray and gamma-ray inspection of weld joints in buttweld fittings and welded pipes to detect sub-surface defects, porosity and incomplete fusion that visual inspection cannot find.
Chemical & Mechanical Testing
Tensile strength, yield strength, elongation, hardness (Brinell, Rockwell) and impact tests are performed in our lab. Chemical analysis confirms carbon, chromium, nickel and molybdenum content.
Visual & Dimensional Inspection
Every product is visually inspected for surface defects and measured against ASME, DIN and ISO dimensional tolerances using calibrated instruments. We check OD, wall thickness, length and thread profiles.

Common Questions
Frequently Asked 
Questions
Is Sachiya Steel a manufacturer or a trader of pipe fittings and flanges?
We are a manufacturer. Sachiya Steel International has its own in-house production facility in Mumbai, India, where we make buttweld and forged pipe fittings, flanges, fasteners and DIN 3015 tube clamps. Because we manufacture rather than trade, we control raw-material selection, machining, finishing and inspection in-house — and provide mill test certificates with every order.
What types of pipe fittings does Sachiya Steel manufacture?
We manufacture buttweld fittings (elbows, tees, reducers, crosses, bends, end caps, stub ends), forged fittings (socket weld and threaded elbows, tees, couplings, unions, plugs, bushings, olets) and flanges (slip-on, weld neck, blind, socket weld, lap joint, threaded, orifice, puddle, split) in stainless steel, carbon steel, alloy steel and duplex steel to ASTM, ASME, DIN and ISO standards.
What are DIN 3015 tube clamps and what materials are available?
DIN 3015 tube clamps are standardised pipe and tube clamping systems used in hydraulic, pneumatic and industrial piping. We manufacture DIN 3015 Part 1 (standard/light series), Part 2 (heavy series) and Part 3 (twin series) clamps in polypropylene (PP), aluminium, carbon steel, stainless steel SS 304, SS 316 and SS 316L. Specialty options include anti-vibration, rubber-lined and high-temperature clamps.
Which countries does Sachiya Steel export to?
We export pipe fittings, flanges, pipes & tubes, fasteners and tube clamps to more than 100 countries across the Middle East, Europe, Americas, Africa, Asia-Pacific and CIS regions including Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Iraq, Germany, UK, France, Italy, Russia, Turkey, USA, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Nigeria, South Africa, Egypt, Kenya, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, South Korea, Japan, Australia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and many others. We handle complete export documentation and freight forwarding.
What material grades do you offer for fasteners?
Our fasteners (bolts, nuts, screws, washers, threaded rods, studs, rings) are available in stainless steel (SS 304, 316, 316L, 321, 410), carbon steel (grade 4.6, 8.8, 10.9, 12.9), alloy steel (ASTM A193 B7, B8, B16), duplex steel (S31803, S32205), and special alloys including Inconel, Monel, Hastelloy and Titanium.
What types of pipes and tubes does Sachiya Steel manufacture?
We manufacture seamless pipes, welded pipes, ERW pipes, box pipes (square and rectangular), heat exchanger tubes, instrumentation tubes and U-bend tubes in stainless steel, carbon steel, alloy steel and duplex steel. Standard specifications include ASTM A312, A213, A269, A249 and A358. Sizes range from 1/8 inch to 24 inch OD in various wall thicknesses and lengths.
What types of flanges are available from Sachiya Steel?
We manufacture slip-on flanges, weld neck flanges, blind flanges, socket weld flanges, lap joint flanges, threaded flanges, orifice flanges and spectacle blind flanges. Available in stainless steel, carbon steel, alloy steel and duplex steel to ASTM A182, A105 and ASME B16.5, B16.47 standards. Sizes from 1/2 inch to 48 inch in pressure ratings 150# to 2500#.
What certifications does Sachiya Steel International hold?
We are TUV certified and ISO 9001:2015 certified. All our products are manufactured and tested to international standards including ASTM, ASME, DIN, ISO and JIS. We provide mill test certificates (MTC), material traceability reports and compliance documentation with every shipment. We also support third-party inspection at our facility.
What is the minimum order quantity and delivery time?
There is no fixed minimum order quantity — we work with both small and large orders depending on the product. Standard sizes and common grades are available from our 2,000+ metric tonne ready stock with delivery in 3-7 working days. Custom orders and special grades typically take 2-4 weeks depending on specifications.
